verdict.rationale: HubSpot's knowledge base documents a sequences tool that sends a series of targeted, timed emails (the snippet is cut off at what appears to be "email templates"). Its connected-inbox docs say users can send one-to-one emails and sequence emails from inside the CRM and log replies there. That covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the email-templates feature itself (only a truncated reference), detail on sequence steps, enrollment and plan requirements, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
